hypothesis: DeepSeek V4's fp8 dense projections on the per-row fmt-12 GEMV leave most of a device without cooperative matrices idle during prefill; the tiled weight-stationary mm8 kernel (qmatmul_mm8.spv: the weights staged once a tile, the group scale folded at staging, one fp32 accumulator an output over ascending k, split-K where the tile grid would starve) multiplies their throughput without touching any default path (COLI_VK_MM8 stays 0).
model: Synthetic fp8 matrices (e4m3 weights, one power-of-two f32 scale a row a 128-input group, x on the e4m3 grid) in DeepSeek V4 Flash's six real projection shapes O x I (32768x1024, 4096x8192, 1024x4096, 512x4096, 2048x4096, 4096x2048); no checkpoint
command: make -f Makefile VK=1 ARCH=native -j16, then in c/: three runs of COLI_VK_CHAIN_BENCH=mm8 ./tests/test_vk_chain shaders/qmatmul.spv (one trial-N-raw.txt each), S 128, every tile of the table forced in turn; the trial arm is the best tile at the split-K auto rule (COLI_VK_MM8=1, COLI_VK_MM8_SPLITK unset), the baseline the fmt-12 GEMV the knob off keeps (COLI_VK_MM8=0), both under the rows policy the engine's default pins (vkc_gemm_rows 0); tok_s is the validator's fixed key and carries each trial's geometric mean of the six shapes' GMAC/s, the per-shape medians in gmac_s_by_shape and in samples.txt
prompt_hash: sha256: no prompt; the bench's deterministic synthetic data (tests/test_vk_chain.c's own rng)
